name: MinMaxScaleNode
label: Min-Max Scale
description: Scales the values of one or more numeric columns to a target range (default 0 to 1) using the global min/max of each column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric columns to scale.

fields.name: ColumnsToScale
fields.label: Columns To Scale
fields.description: Comma-separated numeric column names to scale.

fields.name: Minimum
fields.label: Minimum
fields.description: The lower bound of the target range. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: Maximum
fields.label: Maximum
fields.description: The upper bound of the target range. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: ScaledDataTable
fields.label: Scaled Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with scaled columns.
